approved: Excise Tariff Amendment (Product Stewardship for Oil) Bill 2023
Climate Change, Energy, the Environment and Water
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would raise the excise duty on certain petroleum-based oils to help make the Product Stewardship for Oil Scheme self-funding.
It would increase the duty rate to 14.2 cents per litre for goods in sub-items 15.1 and 15.2 and to 14.2 cents per kilogram for goods in sub-items 15.3 and 15.4 of the Excise Tariff Act.

The scheme has run a deficit averaging $34.5 million per year for more than four years, and the government expects the change to return $139 million to consolidated revenue over the forward estimates.
Increase the excise duty rate on goods in item 15 to 14.2 cents per litre and 14.2 cents per kilogram.
Address the deficit in the Product Stewardship for Oil Scheme.
Return the scheme to fiscal neutrality.
Oil recyclers, oil refiners, oil importers, and oil users.
Excise Tariff Amendment (Product Stewardship for Oil) Act 2023
